lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: The Enchanted Mall! Built by wizards, abandoned by wizards, haunted by retail.

lines.speaker: Hero
lines.text: What's our objective?

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: The Anchor Store at the center has been... acquiring people. Also I need socks. Two birds, hero.

lines.speaker: Food Court Sovereign
lines.text: YOU APPROACH THE COURT. ALL WHO EAT HERE SERVE HERE. THOSE ARE THE TERMS OF THE SAMPLE.

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: Hero... I ate the sample. I ate FOUR samples.

lines.speaker: Food Court Sovereign
lines.text: FOUR?! THE DEBT IS ENORMOUS. TO ARMS.
The mall's heart. A storefront with no sign, no windows, and doors that open like a yawn.

lines.speaker: The Anchor Store
lines.text: WELCOME. EVERYTHING MUST GO. YOU... ARE EVERYTHING.

lines.speaker: Hero
lines.text: We're just here for the missing people. And socks.

lines.speaker: The Anchor Store
lines.text: THE MISSING PEOPLE ARE IN AISLE NEVER. THE SOCKS ARE EXCELLENT. PREPARE FOR ACQUISITION.

lines.speaker: The Anchor Store
lines.text: GOING... OUT OF... BUSINESS...
The doors exhale four hundred missing shoppers, sixty mall-walkers mid-lap, and one wizard who just wanted a smoothie.

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: Everyone's free! And hero... the socks. They ARE excellent.
A folding table in the atrium. A banner: MEET SIR PRESTIGE, 2PM. It is 4PM. The chairs are empty.

lines.speaker: Sir Prestige
lines.text: The turnout is... intimate. Curated, even. My people say organic reach is DOWN across all kingdoms.

lines.speaker: Hero
lines.text: We could get a pretzel. If you want.

lines.speaker: Sir Prestige
lines.text: ...a pretzel would be agreeable. No photos. Actually — one photo.
The intercom crackles: "WOULD THE GUARDIANS OF A LOST CHILD PLEASE COME TO... EVERYWHERE."

lines.speaker: The Lost Child
lines.text: Have YOU seen my parents? It has been 639 years. They said to wait by the fountain. I HAVE BEEN SO PATIENT.

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: Oh no. Hero, my heart. Can we adopt it? Can we adopt the horrifying mall entity?

lines.speaker: The Lost Child
lines.text: HOLD. HANDS.
The mall directory glows. The YOU ARE HERE dot has been replaced with a dot labeled: YOU ARE INVENTORY.

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: Deep breath, hero. Past those doors is the Anchor Store. Remember the plan: rescue the shoppers, refuse all loyalty programs.

lines.speaker: Hero
lines.text: And the socks.

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: And the socks. Obviously the socks.
